checks.detail: src/tui/mock_tunnels.rs, behind CM_TUI_MOCK_TUNNELS=1 (key m on the VPN screen). Every fixture renders NET/REGION/STATE/APP with a symbol, a word and the evidence age; no row sums the axes into ok. Evidence older than one hour is marked stale. Stop follows I17D-NAV: the question names the consequence, takes the table's place, y/Enter or n/Esc answer it, other keys keep it.

checks.detail: cosmic/res/icons/cm-tunnel-{app-only,partial,blocked}-symbolic.svg, embedded by cosmic/src/tunnel_icons.rs. Single symbolic colour #2e3436, so light and dark themes recolour them; distinct from each other and from the update badges. Rendered at 16 px and 96 px on light and dark backgrounds during review.

24 snapshots: 40x12, 60x18, 80x24, 120x32 in ru, en, de, it, zh, ar. Each asserts the four axes, the failure line and the live session count; non-Russian snapshots must contain no Cyrillic. The German failure text was reworded so a 40-column cut keeps its negation.
